descriptions.text: Invisibility Potion. Guess what this does.

beats.headline: In someone's suitcase
beats.text: Carl unzips the suitcase and pulls out red lingerie: women's clothing, high-heeled shoes and brochures about things to do in Delaware. It is just someone's suitcase, he says, not a real prize. Then Donut points at a bulge in one of the pockets. Inside are three potions, two mana potions and something new. Invisibility Potion. Guess what this does. Oh hell yeah, says Carl, and now the system lets him put everything into his inventory, suitcase and clothes included.

beats.headline: Thirty seconds, intelligence times two
beats.text: As light bursts from the mangled mantaur, the mimic's tongue lashes at Carl, slaps the still-forming god aside and sends it flying. Carl rolls, slams the last item in his hotlist and applies his potion of Invisibility just as the tongue smacks into the spot where he was. Dude! Where'd you go? He is invisible for thirty seconds, his intelligence times two, and he should have put more points into that stat. The mimic roars and belches, and a mass of mouth minions the size of rhinoceroses bursts out, several of them coming his way.

beats.headline: Soaked into a smoke curtain
beats.text: At the infusing trays Carl soaks a Hobgoblin smoke curtain in an invisibility potion, and his Infusion skill rises to level three. The ball, normally red, comes out shining with a multicoloured opalescence: a Hobgoblin Disco Ball, heavy multi-hued smoke that hides all movement inside and bounces to the beat, and blinds its caster as well as the monsters. Infusing smoke curtains makes them inherently unstable, which is why he is not yet trying it with real explosives.

beats.headline: Predator
beats.text: Carl has been collecting invisibility potions, and he makes sure Donut always has a few, because of Predator, one of their newer moves: on his call they both go invisible, Donut switches her sunglasses to infrared, and she rides his shoulder calling out by chat anything she sees. Sorry about this, Bomo, Carl says, and smashes an invisibility potion against the side of the rock monster's head. Bomo disappears. Carl drinks his own just as the timer hits zero, Donut does the same, and they are in Zockau.
